title: Cloudflare Status - Cloudflare Workers - Cron Trigger Activation Issues
text:
Service: Cloudflare Status
Incident: Cloudflare Workers - Cron Trigger Activation Issues
Status: resolved
Impact: minor
Started: 2026-10-13T15:18:01.555Z
Resolved: 2026-10-14T00:09:26.984Z
Updates:
- 2026-10-14T00:09:26.984Z: resolved - This incident has been resolved.
- 2026-10-13T23:10:18.529Z: monitoring - We are continuing to monitor for any further issues.
- 2026-10-13T15:19:04.428Z: identified - The issue has been identified and a fix is being implemented.
- 2026-10-13T15:18:01.555Z: investigating - Cloudflare is investigating issues with Workers Cron Triggers. Customers who have recently created or modified a Cron Trigger schedule may find that the schedule is not executing as expected. Pre-existing Cron Trigger schedules that have not been recently modified are not affected.

We are working to identify the cause and mitigate this problem. More updates to follow shortly.

incident.name: Cloudflare Workers - Cron Trigger Activation Issues

incident_updates.body: We are continuing to monitor for any further issues.
The issue has been identified and a fix is being implemented.

Cloudflare is investigating issues with Workers Cron Triggers. Customers who have recently created or modified a Cron Trigger schedule may find that the schedule is not executing as expected. Pre-existing Cron Trigger schedules that have not been recently modified are not affected.

We are working to identify the cause and mitigate this problem. More updates to follow shortly.
